title: Baddha Konasana
notes: Vamana speaks of Baddha Konasana as the greatest of the asanas.

sequence.action: Arms up, palms together, gaze at the fingertips
Fold forward, hands beside the feet, nose to the knees

Join the feet, fold them open, press the heels to the sivani nadi (the nadi between the anus and the genitals), hold the feet open with both hands, lift the chest, and sit with the knees on the floor.
Fold forward, place the head on the floor, and do puraka and rechaka as much as possible.
Cross the legs and lift up on the hands (Uth Pluthi)
Jump the feet between the hands, lift the head
Urdhva Hastasana: arms up, hands together, look at the fingertips

while_holding: Do rechaka and tighten the anus fully.
Pull the stomach in completely, holding the lower abdomen and anus tightly, practicing rechaka and puraka.
benefits: By pulling the stomach in completely, holding the lower abdomen and anus tightly, and practicing rechaka and puraka, terrible afflictions related to the anus, such as constipation and piles, will be destroyed, and indigestion will no longer haunt an aspirant.
Many have had the experience of being relieved of bhagandara [fistula] and mulavyadhi [hemorrhoids] by this asana.
Thus, through its practice, diseases related to the anus and the dhatu will definitely be cured.

verses.sanskrit: Baddhakonasane tishtan gudamakunchayet buddha gudarognivrittih syat satyam satyam bravimyaham
verses.translation: The wise one should retract the anus while in Baddha Konasana as it wards off anal disease, this I declare is true.
